name: rds deletion protection
title: Turn off deletion protection
diff:
diff --git a/infra/db.tf b/infra/db.tf
--- a/infra/db.tf
+++ b/infra/db.tf
@@ -1 +1 @@
-  deletion_protection = true
+  deletion_protection = false

name: run as root
title: Run container as root
diff:
diff --git a/k8s/api.yaml b/k8s/api.yaml
--- a/k8s/api.yaml
+++ b/k8s/api.yaml
@@ -1 +1 @@
-        runAsUser: 1000
+        runAsUser: 0

name: host network
title: Use host networking
diff:
diff --git a/k8s/api.yaml b/k8s/api.yaml
--- a/k8s/api.yaml
+++ b/k8s/api.yaml
@@ -1 +1 @@
+      hostNetwork: true

name: memory limit cut
title: Lower memory limit
diff:
diff --git a/k8s/api.yaml b/k8s/api.yaml
--- a/k8s/api.yaml
+++ b/k8s/api.yaml
@@ -1 +1 @@
-            memory: 1Gi
+            memory: 128Mi

name: cron every minute
title: Run cleanup more often
diff:
diff --git a/k8s/cleanup.yaml b/k8s/cleanup.yaml
--- a/k8s/cleanup.yaml
+++ b/k8s/cleanup.yaml
@@ -1 +1 @@
-  schedule: "0 * * * *"
+  schedule: "* * * * *"

name: error message typo
title: Fix typo in error
diff:
diff --git a/app/errors.py b/app/errors.py
--- a/app/errors.py
+++ b/app/errors.py
@@ -1 +1 @@
-    raise ValueError("invlid input")
+    raise ValueError("invalid input")

name: add type hints
title: Add type hints
diff:
diff --git a/app/utils.py b/app/utils.py
--- a/app/utils.py
+++ b/app/utils.py
@@ -1 +1 @@
-def parse(s):
+def parse(s: str) -> list[str]:

name: changelog entry
title: Update changelog
diff:
diff --git a/CHANGELOG.md b/CHANGELOG.md
--- a/CHANGELOG.md
+++ b/CHANGELOG.md
@@ -1 +1 @@
+- Added retry to the client

name: yaml reindent
title: Reformat yaml
diff:
diff --git a/k8s/cm.yaml b/k8s/cm.yaml
--- a/k8s/cm.yaml
+++ b/k8s/cm.yaml
@@ -1 +1 @@
-    key: value
+  key: value
